name: graph
description: Graph: the Model Engine graph from your local viewer, in a pane. The same drawing as the dashboard, as a picture in the desktop app and in terminals that can draw one, as text cards elsewhere.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Graph off to stop the /doole_graph command, the pane and the status segment.

viewerUrl.title: Viewer address
viewerUrl.description: Where the Model Engine graph viewer listens. Only this computer is accepted: 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1]. Default: http://127.0.0.1:4779.

refreshMs.title: Refresh (milliseconds)
refreshMs.description: How often the open pane asks the viewer for news, from 500 up. Default: 1500.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto lets the viewer pick portrait for a tall pane, tall for a narrow one and wide for a broad one; wide or tall force one.

showBand.title: Show in the bar
showBand.description: Publish a short status such as 'Graph · building · council 1/3' for Bottom Bar to show. Keeps checking the viewer while the pane is closed. Default: off.

showLog.title: Show the session log
showLog.description: Draw the session log under the graph. Default: off, so the graph gets the whole pane.

animate.title: Animate
animate.description: Keep the dotted borders and flowing wires moving while agents work. Off leaves the graph still. Default: on.

animFps.title: Animation speed, desktop (frames per second)
animFps.description: How often the desktop graph moves, 1 to 12; 0 turns the motion off. Default: 6.

animFpsTerminal.title: Animation speed, terminal (frames per second)
animFpsTerminal.description: How many picture frames a second a terminal asks for while agents work, 1 to 6. It slows itself if frames are slow. Default: 3.
